title: 第二十三章 杀戮收获第二十四章 金钱掷
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
地上横七竖八地躺着几具尸体，鲜血将黄土路染成了暗红。
喊杀声越来越近，苏羽当机立断，随着恐慌的人流向集市深处的商铺区退去。那里是城里势力开的商铺，帮派杀红了眼也不会去冲击。
正奔跑间，一道瘦小的身影如泥鳅般在人群中穿梭，猛地撞了苏羽一下。
苏羽眉头一皱，下意识地伸手一摸怀里。
空了！
装着碎银的钱袋，不翼而飞！
“该死！”
苏羽眼中寒芒一闪，那可是他最后的家当！
他二话不说，拔腿就追。
那毛贼个子不高，身法却极其诡异，在拥挤的人潮中左摇右晃，如若无物。反观苏羽，背着五十斤重的粮袋，还要避让惊慌的路人，眼看距离越拉越远。
苏羽直接解下背上的粮袋和杂物，甩在一旁。
卸去负重，苏羽顿觉身轻如燕。
一次扣关的气血全面爆发，他借助蛮横的力量，硬生生在人群中撞开一条路，咬住那道灰色的背影。
那毛贼显然没料到这肥羊如此难缠，慌乱之下，一头扎进了旁边一条死胡同。
苏羽堵住巷口，一步步逼近。
那毛贼退到墙根，见无路可逃，那张涂满灰尘看不清面容的脸上露出一丝苦笑，声音嘶哑难听：“大哥……好汉饶命！钱袋子还你！”
能追上自己，这人大概率是有武道在身，惹到硬茬子了。
说着，他将一个钱袋扔了过来。
苏羽接过钱袋子，看了看里面的碎银还在，先收了起来。
“不够！”

为了追这人，自己花几百文买的东西都扔了，这笔帐，得赚回来。
“爷，我今儿刚开张，真没了……”毛贼摊手，一脸倒霉相。
苏羽冷哼一声，向前逼近，打算亲自动手。
那人一副束手就擒的样子，满脸苦笑。
苏羽没有大意，逼近后，猛的扣向他的咽喉。
眼看就要擒住，那毛贼身体竟以一个不可思议的角度扭曲了一下，像是一张没有骨头的纸片，堪堪避开了这一抓。
“嗯？”
苏羽心中一惊，好滑溜的身法！立马一记白猿靠山撞去，顺势封住他逃跑的路。
然而那人脚步一动，身体灵活的一个转向，竟然躲过了苏羽的撞击，顺势绕到了另一侧，朝着缺口就逃了过去。
“好身法！”
苏羽都忍不住又赞叹了一句，身体一个急转，转头就追了上去。
这身法，如此精妙！若能学到手……
那人在前方逃跑，见到身后苏羽又追了上来，顿时一阵心苦。
咬咬牙，从怀中又掏出一个钱袋子，扔了出去。
然而苏羽看都没看一眼，继续追道，“我要身法！”
那人刚逃到巷口，眼看就要被追上，咬牙又掏出一本发黄的册子。
content_en:
Several corpses were lying on the ground, and the blood dyed the loess road dark red.
The shouts of killing were getting closer and closer. Su Yu made a quick decision and followed the flow of panicked people towards the shopping area deep in the market. There are shops opened by the city's forces, and the gangs will not attack them even if they are jealous.
While running, a thin figure shuttled through the crowd like a loach and bumped into Su Yu violently.
Su Yu frowned and subconsciously reached out to touch his arms.
Empty!
The purse containing broken silver disappeared!
"Damn it!"
Su Yu's eyes flashed coldly, that was his last possession!
Without saying a word, he chased after her.
The thief was not tall, but his movements were extremely strange. He swayed left and right in the crowded crowd as if he were nothing. Su Yu, on the other hand, was carrying a fifty-pound grain bag and had to avoid panicked passers-by, seeing the distance getting further and further away.
Su Yu directly took off the food bag and sundries on his back and threw them aside.
After removing the burden, Su Yu suddenly felt as light as a swallow.
The energy and blood of a push broke out in full force. With the help of his brute strength, he forced his way through the crowd and bit the gray figure.
The thief obviously didn't expect that the fat sheep would be so difficult to deal with. In a panic, he plunged into a dead end next to him.
Su Yu blocked the entrance of the alley and approached step by step.
The thief retreated to the wall. Seeing that there was no way to escape, a bitter smile appeared on his face that was covered with dust and his face could not be seen clearly. His voice was hoarse and unpleasant: "Brother... spare your life, good man! Give you back your money bag!"
If he can catch up with him, he most likely has martial arts skills and is in trouble.
As he spoke, he threw a money bag over.
Su Yu took the money bag, looked at the broken silver inside, and collected it first.
"Not enough!"
In order to chase this person, I threw away all the things I bought for several hundred yuan. I had to earn back this debt.
"Sir, I just opened today, I'm really gone..." The thief spread his hands with a look of misfortune on his face.
Su Yu snorted coldly and moved forward, planning to take action himself.
The man looked helpless and had a wry smile on his face.
Su Yu was not careless. After approaching, he fiercely thrust towards his throat.
Just as he was about to be captured, the thief's body twisted at an incredible angle, like a boneless piece of paper, barely avoiding the grasp.
"Huh?"
Su Yu was shocked, what a slippery movement! He immediately hit the white ape against the mountain, blocking his escape path.
However, the man moved his steps and turned his body flexibly to avoid Su Yu's impact. He went around to the other side and escaped towards the gap.
"Good form!"
Su Yu couldn't help but praise again, turned around sharply, turned around and chased after him.
This body technique is so exquisite! If you can learn how to do it...
The man was running away in front, and when he saw Su Yu chasing after him again, he suddenly felt distressed.
Gritting his teeth, he took out another money bag from his arms and threw it out.
However, Su Yu didn't even look at it and continued to chase, "I want body skills!"
The man had just escaped to the alley, and when he saw that he was about to be caught up, he gritted his teeth and took out another yellowed book.
